subject: FinnHealth pilot: commitment incentive + VPC packaging exception (VP/CFO signoff needed)
messages:
From: Katie Price <katie.price@finnhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-18T10:22:00Z
Subject: Commercial terms for FinnHealth pilot
Attachments: FinnHealth_RFP_v2.pdf

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking time last week. FinnHealth is excited to pilot Redwood in a VPC deployment across our three core regions (NY, MN, remote testing cluster). Attached is the updated RFP with expected token volumes, latency SLO targets, and a preliminary security checklist.

To move quickly we need a commercial anchor that makes the pilot budgetable for our procurement committee. High level ask: 12-month committed pilot, target TCV $420k (monthly phasing), and an onboarding credit or one-time packaging waiver to offset VPC setup.

Can Redwood provide a committed discount and a one-time VPC packaging waiver? We have in-house compliance but will need an indemnity addendum drafted. Aaron Gold (cc'd) is our counsel.

Best,
Katie
Katie Price
Head of Purchasing, FinnHealth
procurement@finnhealth.com

---
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Price <katie.price@finnhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-18T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Commercial terms for FinnHealth pilot
Attachments: proposed_term_sheet_v1.xlsx

Hi Katie — thanks for the RFP, looked through volumes and latency profiles. We can be flexible to help the pilot land. Initial commercial read: we can offer up to a 30% commitment discount off list for a 12-month committed pilot, plus an onboarding credit applied in month 1 to offset a portion of VPC packaging/setup.

Two important notes: 1) the VPC packaging waiver is operationally material and needs an exception approved by finance/CFO, and 2) any indemnity/addendum will need legal review (we'll want to see the proposed language). I've attached a one-page term sheet that mirrors the ask.

Marcus — looping you in for guidance on the credit sizing and to escalate if we need VP/CFO approval for an exception to our packaging policy.

Katie — would you be available for a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk the security checklist and finalize the MOP?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-19T09:18:00Z
Subject: FW: FinnHealth pilot: commercial read + escalation
Attachments: proposed_term_sheet_v1.xlsx

Team — quick context: FinnHealth is a strategic target in the payer vertical; high visibility, good reference potential, and realistic volume that fills a Dedicated pool on month 2.

Ask from client: 12-month committed pilot, $420k TCV, wants a one-time VPC packaging waiver (to avoid a $35k tech-onboard line) and an onboarding credit. I recommend we approve a one-time package waiver up to $25k and a $20k onboarding credit if we get the 12-month commitment and signed PO within 14 days. That equates to ~11% upfront concession but preserves the 30% price discount tied to committed usage.

Why approve: pipeline acceleration into Q3, potential multi-region Dedicated conversion in 9–12 months, and low legal risk if we gate indemnity language and require logs retention terms.

Requesting Aditya and Marissa to confirm approval for the packaging exception + onboarding credit. Numbers below:
- List ARR equivalent: $560k/year (list)
- Proposed discount: 30% -> effective $392k/year pre-credit
- One-time concessions requested: $25k packaging waiver + $20k onboarding credit = $45k
- Net TCV after credits: $347k net recognized over 12 months (approx)

If approved, Priya please proceed to finalize term sheet and issue DocuSign link.

-Marcus
VP, Sales Operations
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-19T11:02:00Z
Subject: Approval request: FinnHealth packaging waiver + onboarding credit (FN-2028-1937)
Attachments: approval_conditions_summary.pdf

Marissa — brief ask: recommend approve an exception for FinnHealth as outlined below. This is time-sensitive; PRC wants signed PO by EOD Tuesday to secure board review window.

Summary: 12-month committed pilot, forecasted token usage matches our Dedicated economics, strong likelihood to convert to a Dedicated contract with expansion. Proposed concessions: one-time packaging waiver $25k (operational), onboarding credit $20k, maintained discount of 30% on committed usage.

Mitigations we will apply: 1) require signed PO with MAU/Tokens floor, 2) limit waiver to first 30 days, 3) indemnity addendum to be reviewed and approved by Legal prior to DocuSign completion, 4) require monthly usage reporting and a rollback clause if usage < 40% of committed in any month for >2 months.

Financial impact: conservative net TCV ~ $347k; expected lifetime value > $1.1M if converted.

Can you approve the packaging exception + onboarding credit? If yes, please confirm any additional finance constraints (revenue recognition treatment, GL mapping) and whether legal should be asked to redline immediately.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
VP, Commercial
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aaron Gold <aaron@goldlegal.com>
Date: 2028-04-19T16:47:00Z
Subject: RE: Approval request: FinnHealth packaging waiver + onboarding credit (FN-2028-1937)
Attachments: approval_conditions_summary.pdf

Aditya — thanks for the clear memo. Approve the exception with these conditions:
1) Packaging waiver capped at $20k (reduce Marcus's proposed amount by $5k).
2) Onboarding credit approved at $15k, applied as a prepaid contra-revenue and amortized over the first 3 months for recognition clarity.
3) Legal must sign off on indemnity language and we require the rollback clause as drafted.
4) Require finance to receive signed PO and invoice wiring details before credit is applied.

Request that Marcus update the term sheet to reflect these numbers and that Priya hold the DocuSign until Legal confirms indemnity language. Once PO is received and legal acknowledges, Finance (cc'd) will route the GL code for recognition.

Approved with conditions — please action quickly, but do not commit additional concessions.

Marissa Cole
Chief Financial Officer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
